rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps or fully address the user’s requests. Issues: (1) No clear user authentication step was performed or evidenced before acting. (2) The agent executed an order-changing write (modified payment method to Visa) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action. (3) The agent failed to answer the user’s questions about the gift card balance and whether a gift card can be applied to the order, and did not clearly state which card was originally used (only implied Mastercard). (4) The statement that an amount previously charged to the Mastercard will be refunded is unsupported by the provided tool outputs and may be inaccurate for a pending order (often an authorization is voided, not refunded). While tools were used to look up user and order details, the core policy requirements—authentication, confirmation before writes, and complete, correct information—were not met.
